_notes.schema: Per KPI: key (stable id), label/label_en, aliases (old labels still accepted by the baselines route), parquet, unit/unit_en/unit_kind (count|percent_rate|per_mille_rate|currency), source_code/source_title(_en), definition(_en), measure additive|non_additive, partitions = columns collapsed (declared complete disjoint partitions, FIX-02 declared_partitions), weights = aligned weight parquet for non-additive measures, allow_approximation = permit a named unweighted mean when no weights exist, suppress = reason the KPI is not shown.
_notes.unemployment: SOM103A has only Masculin/Feminin rows. The both-sexes rate is the registered_unemployment_county recipe (SOM101E year-end counts recover the active population by sex); Bucharest lacks SOM101E rows in the fetch and is omitted with its range.
_notes.wage: FOM106E has no all-activities total row; the net_earnings_county recipe weights CAEN sections × sex by FOM104F employees and reproduces the INS national total.
_notes.rates: Birth/death rates are published for Urban/Rural only; they are combined with POP105A resident-population weights per residence area and year (so periods before POP105A starts in 2012 are not shown).

county.source_title_en: Resident population on 1 January by age group, sex and residence area

county.label: Rata șomajului înregistrat
county.source_title: Rata șomajului pe sexe, macroregiuni, regiuni de dezvoltare și județe
county.source_title_en: Unemployment rate by gender, macroregions, development regions and counties
county.definition: Rata șomajului înregistrat pentru ambele sexe (șomeri înregistrați față de populația activă civilă). INS o publică doar pe sexe în datele noastre; rata totală se reconstituie din numărul de șomeri la sfârșitul anului (SOM101E) și ratele pe sexe.
county.definition_en: Registered unemployment rate for both sexes (registered unemployed relative to the civilian active population). Our data has it only by sex; the total rate is reconstructed from the year-end unemployed (SOM101E) and the rates by sex.
county.method_note: Reconstituit: populația activă pe sexe = șomeri / rată; rata totală = total șomeri / total populație activă. Reproduce ratele regionale publicate.
county.method_note_en: Reconstructed: active population by sex = unemployed / rate; total rate = total unemployed / total active population. Reproduces the published regional rates.

county.label: Câștig salarial net mediu lunar
county.source_title: Câștigul salarial mediu net lunar pe activități CAEN, sexe și județe (ponderat cu salariații din FOM104F)
county.source_title_en: Average net monthly earnings by CAEN activity, sex and county (weighted by FOM104F employees)
county.definition: Câștigul salarial mediu net lunar al tuturor salariaților din județ. INS publică acest total, dar el lipsește din datele noastre; îl reconstituim ca medie a câștigurilor pe secțiuni CAEN și sexe, ponderată cu numărul mediu de salariați (verificat: totalul național 2024 = 4.959 lei, ca la INS).
county.definition_en: Average net monthly earnings of all employees in the county. INS publishes this total but it is missing from our data; we reconstruct it as the mean of earnings by CAEN section and sex weighted by the average number of employees (checked: the 2024 national total = 4,959 lei, as published by INS).
county.method_note: Reconstituit: medie ponderată cu numărul mediu de salariați (FOM104F) pe secțiuni CAEN și sexe; reproduce totalul național publicat de INS.
county.method_note_en: Reconstructed: mean weighted by the average number of employees (FOM104F) over CAEN sections and sexes; reproduces the national total INS publishes.
